Generated Narrative: CodeSystem patient-knowledge-source

This case-sensitive code system https://nih-ncpi.github.io/ncpi-fhir-ig-2/CodeSystem/patient-knowledge-source defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
traditional TraditionalThe knowledge comes from traditional sources like a form filled out by a patient or information copied from an external traditional source like government records.
inferred InferredThe knowledge is inferred from indirect evidence. For example, the existence of one patient's mother can be inferred from the existence of the patient.
